policy: per PROTOCOL v1.0 §2.4 + gap analysis Finding 5: preserved != trusted. A corpus's directory placement (published/, ground-truth/, etc.) does NOT confer authority. Two orthogonal axes govern the source-level prerequisites: verification_status (is the source / citation retrievable?) and reference_eligibility (may this corpus participate in independent-reference validation?). VERIFIED + ELIGIBLE are NECESSARY source-level prerequisites but are NOT sufficient on their own. The reference gate (can_satisfy_validation_gate) additionally requires an explicit claim_id that is present in eligible_claim_ids. Unscoped queries fail closed. Ruleset promotion is DISABLED / FAIL-CLOSED today (can_promote_ruleset_using returns False unconditionally). Ground-truth designation is ALWAYS FAIL-CLOSED. Silent authoritative fixture copying is ALWAYS FAIL-CLOSED.

verification_status.UNVERIFIED: the citation could not be independently verified from this host (book not held, ISBN not retrievable, page cannot be cross-checked, etc.)
verification_status.VERIFIED: the source has been fetched / the citation has been confirmed against a retrievable record (the source itself may still be non-authoritative — see reference_eligibility)

reference_eligibility.INELIGIBLE: the corpus may inform the work but cannot satisfy an independent-reference validation gate, even if VERIFIED. reasons include: practitioner / non-academic source, source does not actually cover the claimed calendrical relationship, source is older than the regime it claims to describe.
reference_eligibility.ELIGIBLE: the corpus may satisfy an independent-reference validation gate for calendar correctness

authority_basis.scholarly: academic publication, peer-reviewed or from a recognized scholarly press
authority_basis.customary: attested by a Balinese customary authority (pemangku, bendesa, etc.)
authority_basis.institutional: attested by a state institution (university, ministry, heritage body)
authority_basis.practitioner: practitioner calendar (commercial or community) — may be VERIFIED but is generally INELIGIBLE for authoritative calendar validation
authority_basis.software_reference: a software implementation that itself cites a verifiable source (the source is what matters, not the software)
authority_basis.unknown: the basis could not be classified — UNVERIFIED by default

gate_predicates.can_satisfy_validation_gate: VERIFIED + ELIGIBLE + eligible_claim_ids non-empty + claim_id in eligible_claim_ids. CLAIM-SCOPED: caller MUST supply claim_id. Returns False unconditionally for unscoped (claim_id=None) queries.
gate_predicates.can_promote_ruleset_using: RETURNS FALSE UNCONDITIONALLY. The executable promotion-authority mechanism does not exist yet. No caller input — including a complete RulesetPromotionContext with arbitrary strings as governance_authorization_artifact — can authorize a promotion.
gate_predicates.can_be_described_as_ground_truth: RETURNS FALSE UNCONDITIONALLY. Ground-truth designation requires an explicit accepted-rule mechanism with appropriate human/governance authority that this module does not yet implement.
gate_predicates.can_be_silently_copied_to_authoritative_: RETURNS FALSE UNCONDITIONALLY. There is no condition under which evidence may be silently promoted into an authoritative fixture.

removed_source_level_booleans_2026-09-16: may_satisfy_validation_gate and may_be_described_as_ground_truth have been removed from corpus entries because they implied source-level boolean authority that is forbidden under the v3.0 claim-scoped model. Use verification_status, reference_eligibility, and eligible_claim_ids (the structured fields) instead. may_justify_ruleset_promotion is retained as DOCUMENTATION-ONLY and is NOT consulted by any gate function.
separation_from_ceremonial_tiers: this status governs the bibliographic / evidence-chain layer for conformance corpora. It does NOT affect Dewata's ceremonial/record provenance tiers (computed / registered / predicted / verified) governed by PROTOCOL §2.6. A corpus's verification_status: VERIFIED does NOT imply 'verified' in the ceremonial provenance ladder.
